summary: Coca-Cola FEMSA filed a Form 6-K containing a report on its adherence to the Code of Best Corporate Practices for fiscal year 2025, as required by Mexican Stock Exchange regulations. The filing consists of a compliance checklist covering responsible business conduct, sustainability culture, shareholder meeting operations, and board election processes. There are no disclosed financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. This is a routine regulatory disclosure with no actionable corporate event.
